verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero product and circle to a tiny icon at the top, so the key imagery is effectively lost. Its right column also runs in the wrong order: CTA first, then three pill badges stacked like buttons, then the body copy jammed into the bottom-right corner, far from the headline it supports. B keeps the product circle at a usable size and pairs it well with the headline on the left, but its right column has the same jumbled order (CTA above the badges, body copy last and cramped into the corner), and the tilted Free Delivery pill dropped into the stack looks accidental.
